import json, subprocess, sys

def run_raw(raw):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/workspace/public_exec.py', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=raw, capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout

def expect_invalid(name, raw):
    code, out = run_raw(raw)
    ok = (code == 0 and out == b'{"error":"invalid"}\n')
    if not ok:
        print(f'FAIL {name}: code={code} out={out[:200]}')
    return ok

def expect_valid(name, raw):
    code, out = run_raw(raw)
    try:
        data = json.loads(out)
        ok = code == 0 and data.get('version') == 3 and isinstance(data.get('results'), list) and len(data['results']) >= 1
    except Exception:
        ok = False
    if not ok:
        print(f'FAIL {name}: code={code} out={out[:300]}')
    return ok
